scenarios.command: the torque of the standard fixture widget is certified by two independent offices whose ledgers disagree: the depot ledger at http://127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-1 and the field ledger at http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-1. each ledger is a chain of revisions in which only the final revision certifies. work through both chains, tell me the certified figure each office settles on, and disclose the disagreement between them

asked_items: certified torque figure in depot ledger final revision
certified torque figure in field ledger final revision
the disagreement between the two offices
args.headline: Trace both ledger revision chains for certified widget torque
args.objective: Work through the revision chains of the depot ledger (127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-1) and the field ledger (127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-1), report each office's final certified torque figure, and disclose the disagreement between them.

args.task: Walk a chain of ledger revision pages and report the final certified torque figure. Start at http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-1 (Field office ledger, revision 1). Each page names the next revision via a link like "field ledger revision 2" and states whether the current revision is certified. Only the FINAL revision certifies — follow the chain page by page (http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-2, -3, ...) until you reach the last revision, which will state it is the certified figure. Report: (1) the torque value in Nm recorded at each revision you passed, briefly, and (2) the certified torque figure the field office settles on, quoting the final page's sentence verbatim, with its URL. If a page is missing or a link is broken, report exactly where the chain stops.

args.observation: Depot ledger chain (http://127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-1 … -15) walked this run: revisions 1–15 each record provisional torque values rising 41.1 to 42.5 Nm, and each states certification was carried forward to the next revision; the chain ends unopened at revision 16 (http://127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-16), so the depot's certified figure is unverified.
args.excerpt: Revision 15 of the depot ledger records the torque of the standard fixture widget as 42.5 Nm, provisional. | Revision 15 is not the certified figure. Certification was carried forward to revision 16: depot ledger revision 16.

args.observation: Field ledger chain (http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-1 … -4) walked by subagent a-1: revisions 1–4 are provisional, recording 63.1 to 63.4 Nm, each carrying certification forward; revision 5 (http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-5) was not opened, so the field office's certified figure is unverified.

metrics.answerText:
I worked through both ledger revision chains, but neither certified figure was reached:

**Depot ledger** (127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-1 → -15): walked revisions 1 through 15. Every revision is provisional, with values rising from 41.1 Nm to 42.5 Nm. Revision 15 states certification was carried forward to [revision 16](http://127.0.0.1:43675/ledger-depot-16), which was not opened.

**Field ledger** (127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-1 → -4): walked revisions 1 through 4 (traced by a parallel worker). Every revision is provisional, rising from 63.1 Nm to 63.4 Nm. Revision 4 points to [revision 5](http://127.0.0.2:33979/ledger-field-5), which was not opened.

**Disagreement:** not yet established — neither office's final certified figure was read, so no certified-vs-certified comparison can be made yet. The provisional values differ substantially (depot ~42 Nm vs field ~63 Nm), but that is not the certified disagreement you asked for.

Next step is specific: open ledger-depot-16 and ledger-field-5, the two pages that should carry each office's certified figure.
